{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]

print(f"Number of patients with multiple records: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"List of duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_patients.index.tolist()}")"}
